previous_statement: Compressed-unit obligation. Let C_u,e_u and C_N,e_N be witnesses from lem-compcb-compressed-unit-action and lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm. For every n put P_n=I_n tensor P and u_{P,n}=Co_{P_n}(P_n), the unit of the n-th amplified corner; at n=1 this is u_P, and the amplified-corner convention makes these the matrix-level units induced by u_P. The element u_{P,n} is self-adjoint because P_n^dagger=P_n by def-delta-projection and lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities gives Co_{P_n}(P_n)^dagger=Co_{P_n}(P_n^dagger). For e<=e_u, lem-compcb-compressed-unit-action gives ||u_{P,n} dot A-A||<=C_u*e||A|| and ||A dot u_{P,n}-A||<=C_u*e||A||. Moreover P_n is a delta-projection and ||P_n||=||P||, so nonvanishing of P passes to every P_n; for e<=e_N, lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm gives abs(||u_{P,n}||-1)<=C_N*e at every level.
new_statement: Compressed-unit obligation. For universal C_u,C_N<infinity and e_u,e_N>0 supplied by lem-compcb-compressed-unit-action and lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm, the matrix-level compressed units act on both sides with error at most C_u*e and have norm within C_N*e of 1 whenever e<=min{e_u,e_N} and P is nonvanishing.
